name: tavily
description: Web search, page extraction, site crawling and mapping, and deep research for agents
long_description: Bring a Tavily API key; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the key reads the key's usage counters (GET /usage), which costs no credits. A Sprite can then search the web, extract page content, crawl and map sites, start a research task and poll its result, and read usage. Every search, extract, crawl, map and research request uses your Tavily credits (1,000 are free each month on the Researcher plan). API key management, organization usage, logs and feedback endpoints are not forwarded.

messages.400: Tavily rejected the request (%{status}); check the body's detail.error
messages.422: Tavily could not validate the request parameters; see detail for the field
messages.429: Tavily rate limit reached; wait for the Retry-After header and retry
messages.432: Tavily plan or key usage limit exceeded; raise the limit or upgrade at app.tavily.com
messages.433: Tavily pay-as-you-go limit exceeded; raise it at app.tavily.com
messages.434: Tavily live content fetching (max_age_hours) is unavailable on this plan right now; retry without it
messages.provider_unreachable: Could not reach Tavily; retry later

presentation.tagline: Search, extract, crawl and research the web from a Sprite without putting your Tavily key on it.
presentation.setup: Sign in at app.tavily.com, open the home page's API Keys section and create a key (it starts with `tvly-`). The free Researcher plan includes 1,000 credits a month.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key reads `GET /usage` and spends no credits. Basic search costs 1 credit and advanced search costs 2. Extract costs 1 credit per 5 successful URLs, or 2 with `extract_depth: "advanced"`. Map costs 1 credit per 10 successful pages, or 2 with `instructions`. Crawl adds the mapping and extraction costs. Research costs 4 to 110 credits with `mini` and 15 to 250 with `pro`. Add `include_usage: true` where supported to see what the request cost. Pay-as-you-go is $0.008 per credit.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `POST /search`, `POST /extract`, `POST /crawl`, `POST /map`, `POST /research`, `GET /research/:request_id` and `GET /usage` are forwarded. API key management, organization usage, request logs and feedback are not. Tavily's rate limits apply per account: 100 requests a minute on the free plan, 1,000 or more on paid plans, with `/crawl` and `/map` at 100 a minute, `/research` at 20 and `/usage` at 10 per 10 minutes.

usage_notes: For `POST /crawl`, set `timeout` below the gateway's 120-second response deadline. Tavily defaults to 150 seconds. Use a smaller `limit` or `max_depth` if a crawl takes too long.

Research runs in the background: `POST /research` returns 201 with a `request_id`, and `GET /research/:request_id` answers 202 while it is pending and 200 when it is complete or failed. Streaming (`stream: true`) sends Server-Sent Events on the same route.
Error bodies are `{"detail": {"error": "..."}}`; a 422 lists the invalid fields under `detail` instead. Tavily uses 432 and 433 for plan and pay-as-you-go limits, which the gateway passes through.
